description: Screen one XBRL concept for a single fiscal period across all filers at once (e.g. Revenues for FY2023), returning each company's reported value. This is the cross-sectional counterpart to stocks_financial_concept, which returns one company's series over time. Paginate with cursor/limit.

period.description: Fiscal period, e.g. FY2023 or 2023Q4 (as documented).
